Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: Bank of South Sudan launched National Instant Payment System ([TechCabal](https://techcabal.com/2025/02/07/south-sudan-launches-instant-payments/)); SSIPS interbank launched Oct 2025 ([Financial Afrik](https://www.financialafrik.com/en/2025/10/14/south-sudan-launches-its-first-electronic-interbank-payment-system/)); partially deployed as integrates ACH/RTGS/IFT but recent launch.
